Report DescriptionNOAA/NESDIS MSPR ISSUED POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 01-03-2023 REPORT TIME: 2355 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: NUECES BAY 751 IMAGE DATE: 12-31-2022 IMAGE TIME: 1658 UTC DATA SOURCE: LANDSAT9 MODE: MULTISPECTRAL RESOLUTION: 30 METER LOCATION: 27°52"07" N/97°21"53" W AREA: 1.80 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS REPORT IS RELATED TO HOTLINE 10548, THE INGLESIDE DOCK OIL LEAK FROM 12/24/2022 (SEE ALSO NRC REPORTS 1356415 ON 30 DEC., 1355881, AND 1355879). THE ANOMALY WAS MADE UP OF MULTIPLE DARK PATCHES, POSSIBLY TARBALLS, SPREAD ACROSS AN AREA 2.25 NM LONG AND .75 NM ACROSS AND LOCATED NEAR THE SHORELINE IN THE NE AREA OF NUECES BAY, INSIDE CORPUS CHRISTI BAY, TEXAS. CONSIDERING THE HOTLINE UPDATES AND CONFIRMATION THAT THE SPILL HAD FLOWED INTO NUECES BAY, THE REPORT WAS ISSUED WITH MED-HIGH CONFIDENCE DESPITE THE PREVALENCE OF FALSE POSITIVES IN THE AREA. THE POINT SOURCE WAS LOCATED OUTSIDE THE MAP AREA, APPROXIMATELY 9 NM TO THE SE AT THE INGLESIDE DOCK IN CORPUS CHRISTI BAY. WINDS WERE LIGHT, VARIABLE. UNCERTAINTIES: THERE MAY HAVE BEEN MORE PATCHES OF POSSIBLE OIL THAN OUTLINED IN THIS REPORT BUT THE PREVALENCE OF FALSE POSITIVES IN THE BAY MADE IT DIFFICULT TO DEFINE ANY FURTHER WITH CONFIDENCE. MAPS AND SHAPEFILES CAN BE ACCESSED AT: WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/

Report Description/// THIS IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT # 1400374 /// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOW: THE AMOUNT OF HYDROGEN PEROXIDE RELEASE IS 0.6%, AND THE AMOUNT OF HYDROGEN FLUORIDE RELEASE IS 0.1% /// BELOW IS THE ORIGINAL REPORT: /// CALLER REPORTS THAT SOMETIME BETWEEN THE PM OF 26TH AND 27TH OF MAY, A TWO- INCH PIPING ON THE FILTER HOUSING AT A METAL PROCESSING FACILITY BURST WHICH WAS CONNECTED TO A STORAGE TANK. THE TANK CONTAINED A PRIMER WITH THE FOLLOWING MATERIALS (BY PERCENTAGE): 85% REVERSE OSMOSIS WATER 12% MPP930 2% HYDROGEN PEROXIDE 1% HYDROGEN FLUORIDE APPROXIMATELY 2200 TOTAL GALLONS RELEASED. MOST OF THE MATERIAL WENT INTO SECONDARY CONTAINMENT, BUT THE BURST PIPING ALSO SPRAYED SOME MATERIAL INTO A STORM DRAIN THAT LED INTO A RETENTION POND. RAIN CONDITIONS ON THE POND LED SOME MATERIAL (POSSIBLY 130 GALLONS) TO RELEASE ONTO THE ADJACENT PROPERTY, INTO AN UNNAMED STREAM, AND THEN INTO BRUCE LAKE. THE FACILITY WAS CLOSED AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT AND WAS DISCOVERED ON THE 27TH.

ORGINIAL REPORT: CALLER STATED THAT TWO TRACTOR TRAILERS COLLIDED. properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1308685
Incident Time: 2021-06-23 13:00:00
Nearest City: Wilson, OK
Location2: NORTH OF CONOCO ROAD
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: OIL: CRUDE
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: CITATION OIL & GAS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 34.156517, -97.352283 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionCALLER IS REPORTING A COMPANY THAT IS OPERATING THE OIL WELLS ON AND NEXT TO HIS PROPERTY HAVE WELLHEADS THAT ARE LEAKING OIL AND SALTWATER ONTO THE GROUND AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. CALLER STATED THE WELLS HAVE BEEN CONSTANTLY LEAKING SINCE AT LEAST NOVEMBER 2020 AND THEY HAVE IMPACTED THE CROPS ON HIS PROPERTY AS WELL AS THE FEDERALLY BUILT DUCK HABITAT. THE OIL CONTAMINATION IN THE SOIL IS AT LEAST 44 INCHES DEEP. CALLER STATED THE COMPANY NEVER CLEANS UP THE SPILLS THEY JUST PUT THIS UNKNOWN WHITE POWDER ON IT AND COVER THE OIL UP WITH DIRT AND CLAY. CALLER IS CONCERNED THAT THIS WHITE MATERIAL COULD BE HAZARDOUS AND THE COMPANY REFUSES TO SHOW HIM A SAFETY DATA SHEET ON WHAT WAS USED. IN ADDITION, THE OKLAHOMA CORPORATION COMMISSION IS INVOLVED AND HAS TAKEN SAMPLES HOWEVER, THE CALLER DOES NOT FEEL THEY ARE DOING A GOOD JOB HANDLING THIS AND IS REQUESTING ASSISTANCE WITH THE EPA. THE RESULTS FROM THE SAMPLES WILL NOT BE IN FOR AT LEAST TWO WEEKS. CALLER ALSO NOTED HE HAS BEEN HAVING SOME HEALTH ISSUES LATELY, AND IS CONCERNED IT COULD BE FROM THE CONTAMINATION, HOWEVER HE IS NOT CERTAIN THAT IT IS. CALLER HAS VIDEO AND PHOTOGRAPHS TO PROVIDE IF NEEDED.

Reported Spill Volume: 250 gallons
Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 1026.3 gallons
USCG RECEIVED A REPORT FROM AN ANONYMOUS WORKER AT A FACILITY NEAR LT 77 MISSISSIPPI RIVER GULF OUTLET, STATING THERE WAS A BLACK AND RAINBOW SHEEN IN THE WATER AROUND THE FACILITY. USCG WAS SENT TO THE LOCATION TO INVESTIGATE. AUXAIR REPORTED 2½ NAUTICAL MILE SHEEN ACROSS THE ENTIRE WIDTH OF THE MISSISSIPPI RIVER GULF OUTLET EXTENDING INTO THE MARSH. THE SUSPECTED SOURCE IS A DAMAGED TANK. AUXAIR SPOKE DIRECTLY WITH DPI WHO REQUESTED PHOTOS AND VIDEO. SHEEN CALCULATOR ESTIMATES 250-300 GALLONS DISCHARGED. THE SPILL IS A RESULT OF A TRANSFER LINE RUPTURE FROM A BARGE LEADING TO A WELL HEAD. AUXAID 91CC FLEW OVER THE SPILL YESTERDAY AND REPORTED SHEEN SIZE.
